title: Possible GitHub personal access token in source
description: A string with the shape of a GitHub personal access token (ghp_ followed by 36 characters) was found in source. Anyone with repository access can use a live token with its full scopes until it is revoked.
remediation: Revoke the token immediately in GitHub settings, audit what it accessed, and replace it with a fine-grained token or GitHub App stored outside version control. This detection does not prove the token is live.
limitation: Shape-only: matches the ghp_ prefix format, which cannot prove a live credential. Short fragments and documentation mentions do not match.

tests.line: see ghp_ docs for available scopes
